content:
Yahoo Finance reported on November 5 that the Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled 3.4%, or more than 1,800 points, while the S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq Composite sank 5.5% into correction territory. Chip stocks took the brunt of the damage, as the leading AI chipmaker fell 9% to pace Dow decliners and another chip designer plunged 17%, the outlet reported.

The slide erased the gains from a day earlier, when the Dow had jumped nearly 1,600 points after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, Yahoo Finance wrote on November 4. Even so, the blue-chip index finished Thursday just 1.9% below its record closing high of 54,349 from early August.

For most of the week, the Dow had looked like the sheltered corner of the market. Yahoo Finance reported on November 2 that the Dow edged up 0.4% while the Nasdaq dropped roughly 1% as investors rotated out of technology names and into consumer cyclical and financial services shares. One household consumer brand has divided opinion lately, and we covered why a well-known TV host is staying away from the sneaker maker after losing money on it .

On Thursday, that cushion gave way, as the focus turned to what a Democratic Congress could mean for the AI buildout, and for the data centers driving it in particular. Data center power and infrastructure stocks fell by double digits, and the Nasdaq 100 was recently more than 10% below its October closing high. The reversal was fast. Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at an equity research firm, pointed out that the VIX volatility index posted its biggest one-day jump in more than two years. It took the Nasdaq just six minutes to erase its entire post-election rally.

Friday brought a partial rebound. Yahoo Finance reported on November 6 that the US added 165,000 jobs in October, and the Nasdaq gained 1.9% while the S&P 500 rose 1% and the Dow added 0.1%. You might also be interested in reading our piece on why a billionaire money manager and a TV host both still like the iPhone maker .

The stronger jobs data lifted Treasury yields and kept Federal Reserve policy at the center of market attention, Reuters reported on November 6, as the price-weighted index of 30 major US companies held roughly flat.

We shared the expanded list of the 10 Worst Dow Stocks To Buy here . You can see the 5 worst stocks below.

For this article, we used Finviz to screen the 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average and calculated each stock's average upside potential, based on analysts' average price target. We picked the 10 stocks with the lowest upside potential and ranked them in descending order of upside. We also list each stock's short interest and number of hedge fund holders as of Q2 2026.

Note: All data was sourced on November 6, 2026.

Advertising and online sales are changing what a Walmart dollar earns. Global eCommerce sales rose 23% in the fiscal second quarter, and global advertising grew 38%, with the US Walmart Connect ad business up 43% excluding Vizio.

Operating income rose 28.8%, boosted by tariff refunds that the retailer said it would put back into lower prices. Management raised its sales and operating income growth guidance for the year, and said it will keep prioritizing investment in price during the second half. Operating cash flow reached $19.7 billion for the first half of the year, which helps fund those price cuts.

Walmart US also posted strong growth across digital. Walmart International also grew, with Sam's Club China reaching record membership counts and Flipkart's advertising business expanding. Sam's Club US showed steady membership growth and more transactions, and nearly half of Walmart's marketplace business now flows through its fulfillment services, which gives outside sellers a reason to stay on the platform. Walmart reports its next quarter later this month, when investors will see how the price investments and the digital businesses are working together.

Our analysis on Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT) can be found here: Walmart (WMT): Can Suppliers Keep Funding Its Inventory Growth?

A new CEO, a record September quarter and a fresh iPhone lineup have given Apple momentum into the holidays. Revenue reached $114.5 billion, up 12%, and iPhone sales set a September-quarter record. Services hit an all-time high, and the installed base of active devices reached a record in every major product category and region.

Profit was strong as well. Diluted earnings per share rose 14%, and the company generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter and returned $28 billion to shareholders. Chief Financial Officer Kevan Parekh said fiscal 2026 capped a year of double-digit earnings growth and all-time record revenue.

Chief Executive John Ternus pointed to the lineup carrying Apple into the holiday season: the iPhone Duo, which he called the most transformational iPhone since the original, the iPhone 18 Pro models, the first Macs with touch, and an all-new Siri AI. Apple also reported a September-quarter record for iPhone upgraders worldwide, and said it gained Mac share globally. Apple also said it grew in the vast majority of the markets it tracks, with September-quarter revenue records in the Americas, Europe, Greater China and the rest of Asia Pacific.

Read our analysis on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) here: Apple (AAPL): Can Longer iPhone Ownership Still Produce More Profit per Customer?

Underwriting discipline is paying off at Travelers. Core income reached $9.18 per diluted share in the third quarter, a core return on equity of 22.1%, and the underlying combined ratio came in at 84.1%. Underwriting results were strong across all three of the insurer's segments.

Even with higher catastrophe losses from severe wind and hail storms, the company produced strong results, helped by favorable development on prior-year reserves and higher net investment income. New business hit a third-quarter record, which shows the insurer is still winning customers as it prices careful

chineseContent:
雅虎财经11月5日报道称，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌3.4%，跌幅超过1800点，标准普尔500指数下跌4.4%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌5.5%，进入调整区间。据该媒体报道，芯片股首当其冲，领先的人工智能芯片制造商股价下跌 9%，追随道琼斯指数下跌，另一家芯片设计公司股价下跌 17%。

雅虎财经 11 月 4 日写道，此次下跌抹去了前一天的涨幅，当时民主党赢得国会参众两院的控制权后，道指上涨了近 1,600 点。即便如此，该蓝筹股指数周四收盘仍仅比 8 月初创下的收盘高点 54,349 点低 1.9%。

在本周的大部分时间里，道琼斯指数看起来就像是市场的避风港。雅虎财经 11 月 2 日报道道琼斯指数小幅上涨 0.4%，而纳斯达克指数下跌约 1%，因为投资者从科技股转向消费周期股和金融服务股。最近，一个家庭消费品牌出现了意见分歧，我们讨论了为什么一位知名电视主持人在亏损后远离这家运动鞋制造商。

周四，随着焦点转向民主党国会对人工智能建设，特别是对推动人工智能建设的数据中心意味着什么，这种缓冲已经消失了。数据中心电力和基础设施股下跌两位数，纳斯达克 100 指数近期较 10 月份收盘高点下跌逾 10%。逆转来得很快。股票研究公司首席市场策略师Shay Boloor指出，VIX波动率指数创下两年多来最大单日涨幅。纳斯达克指数仅用了六分钟就抹去了选举后的全部涨势。

周五带来部分反弹。雅虎财经11月6日报道，美国10月新增就业岗位16.5万个，纳斯达克指数上涨1.9%，标普500指数上涨1%，道指上涨0.1%。您可能还有兴趣阅读我们的文章，了解为什么亿万富翁资金经理和电视主持人仍然喜欢这家 iPhone 制造商。

据路透社 11 月 6 日报道，强劲的就业数据提振了美国国债收益率，并使美联储政策成为市场关注的焦点，美国 30 家主要公司的价格加权指数大致持平。

我们在此分享了道琼斯指数最差 10 只股票的扩展列表。您可以在下面看到最差的 5 只股票。

在本文中，我们使用 Finviz 筛选道琼斯工业平均指数的 30 个成分股，并根据分析师的平均价格目标计算每只股票的平均上涨潜力。我们挑选了上涨潜力最低的 10 只股票，并按照上涨空间降序排列。我们还列出了截至 2026 年第二季度每只股票的空头权益和对冲基金持有者数量。

注：所有数据均来源于 2026 年 11 月 6 日。

广告和在线销售正在改变沃尔玛的美元收入。第二财季全球电子商务销售额增长 23%，全球广告增长 38%，其中美国 Walmart Connect 广告业务（不包括 Vizio）增长 43%。

得益于关税退款（该零售商表示将重新投入到更低的价格中），营业收入增长了 28.8%。管理层上调了今年的销售和营业收入增长指引，并表示下半年将继续优先投资价格。上半年运营现金流达到 197 亿美元，这有助于为降价提供资金。

沃尔玛美国在数字领域也实现了强劲增长。沃尔玛国际公司也实现了增长，山姆会员店中国会员数量达到创纪录水平，Flipkart 的广告业务也在不断扩大。美国山姆会员店的会员数量稳定增长，交易量增加，沃尔玛近一半的市场业务现在通过其履行服务进行，这给了外部卖家留在该平台的理由。沃尔玛将于本月晚些时候公布下一季度的报告，届时投资者将看到价格投资和数字业务如何协同运作。

我们对沃尔玛（纳斯达克股票代码：WMT）的分析可以在这里找到：沃尔玛（WMT）：供应商能否继续为其库存增长提供资金？

新任首席执行官、创纪录的 9 月份季度业绩以及全新的 iPhone 系列为苹果公司的假期注入了动力。收入达到 1145 亿美元，增长 12%，iPhone 销量创下 9 月份季度记录。服务创历史新高，各主要产品类别和地区的活跃设备安装量均创历史新高。

利润也很强劲。稀释后每股收益增长 14%，该季度公司产生 280 亿美元运营现金流，并向股东返还 280 亿美元。首席财务官 Kevan Parekh 表示，2026 财年将实现两位数的盈利增长和创历史新高的收入。

首席执行官 John Ternus 指出了带领苹果进入假日季的产品阵容：iPhone Duo（他称之为自初代以来最具变革性的 iPhone）、iPhone 18 Pro 机型、首款带触摸功能的 Mac 以及全新的 Siri AI。苹果还公布了 9 月份季度全球 iPhone 升级量的记录，并表示 Mac 的全球份额有所增加。苹果还表示，其追踪的绝大多数市场都实现了增长，美洲、欧洲、大中华区和亚太其他地区的 9 月份季度营收均创历史新高。

请阅读我们对 Apple (纳斯达克股票代码：AAPL) 的分析：Apple (AAPL)：iPhone 拥有时间越长仍能为每位客户带来更多利润吗？

Travelers 的承保纪律正在得到回报。第三季度稀释后每股核心收入达到9.18美元，核心股本回报率为22.1%，基本综合成本率为84.1%。该保险公司所有三个部门的承保业绩均表现强劲。

尽管强风和冰雹造成的灾难损失较高，但得益于上一年储备的良好发展和较高的净投资收入，该公司仍取得了强劲的业绩。新业务创下第三季度纪录，这表明该保险公司仍在赢得客户，因为其定价谨慎
